scientific_integrity: All asymptotic theorems rest on a uniform Stirling/tail argument; executable finite consistency checks are supplementary, not proofs. Prior full-text access to a plausible 2024 paper was incomplete.
scientific_limitations: All fixed-index, fixed-window scaling; circular regular nodes with constant data, no irregular-node result or uniform growing-index classification. Exact finite Poisson residue identities and first qualitative vacuum crossover are previously known.
title: An exact alias-mode staircase and critical mixing laws for circular Fock interpolation
